title: Hugo page front matter
description: The front matter of a Markdown file under content/. It lists Hugo's own keys; add the keys your theme reads, each with a description, or put them under params.

title.description: The page title, shown in the heading, the browser tab, and lists.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

linkTitle.description: A shorter title for menus and links.

summary.description: The summary shown in lists instead of the first paragraph.

publishDate.description: Hugo does not publish the page before this date.

expiryDate.description: Hugo does not publish the page after this date.

draft.description: true keeps the page out of the built site unless Hugo runs with --buildDrafts.

weight.description: The page's position in lists and menus: lower comes first.

slug.description: The last part of the page's URL, instead of the file name.

url.description: The page's whole URL path, such as /about/. Overrides slug.

aliases.description: Old URLs that redirect to this page.

layout.description: The template the page uses, when not the default one for its type.

type.description: The content type, which picks the template folder; the first folder under content/ by default.

keywords.description: Keywords for related content and meta tags.

translationKey.description: Links translations of the same page when their file names differ.

menus.description: The menus this page appears in: a menu name, a list of names, or a map of menu settings.

params.description: Your own values, read in templates as .Params.

cascade.description: Front matter that the pages below this section inherit.

build.description: Build options: list, render, and publishResources.

outputs.description: The output formats for this page, such as html and markdown.

sitemap.description: Sitemap settings: changefreq, priority, and disable.

headless.description: true for a leaf bundle that has no page of its own.

markup.description: The content format, when the file extension does not say it.

isCJKLanguage.description: true when the page is in Chinese, Japanese, or Korean, for word counts.

resources.description: Metadata for the files in the page bundle.
